welcomeIntro.message: This extension groups your tabs for you: a tab you open from another tab joins it in a group, and tabs going to sites you choose move into their own colored group.

welcomeStep1.message: Open the Groups tab and click “New group”.

welcomeStep2.message: Pick a name and a color, e.g. “Dev”, yellow.

welcomeStep3.message: Add a domain under it, e.g. github.com. Subdomains match too (gist.github.com).

welcomeStep4.message: Open github.com: the tab moves into the yellow “Dev” group by itself.

welcomeTip1.message: Open a link in a new tab and both tabs are grouped automatically.

welcomeTip2.message: Alt+T opens a new tab inside the current tab's group.

welcomeTip3.message: The Behavior tab sets automatic group names and whether single-tab groups are disbanded.

welcomePrivacy.message: Everything stays on your device; the extension sends no data anywhere.
